blocks.title: AI-native experiences, generative interfaces and building prototypes in code
paragraphs: I explore products where AI helps interpret intent and shapes the interface around the task. I build working prototypes to test the interaction, its limits and how it feels in use.

blocks.title: Intent-driven, adaptive systems
paragraphs: Interfaces that respond to what you want to achieve, adapting their tools and presentation to the task and its context. I think this is where interaction design is heading. I’m developing these ideas in an article.
